caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest or cabinet with a rectangular shape and sturdy legs. The chest is primarily brown with various painted decorative elements. The front features three upper panels, with the central panel displaying the text "EL 1705" encircled by a dotted pattern. The two panels on either side of the central panel each contain a stylized floral motif with symmetrical stems and blooms. Below these is a wide lower drawer also adorned with floral patterns, featuring predominantly green, red, and yellow tones. The edges and corners of the chest are outlined with lighter-colored trim, and the top has a slight overhang. The chest is set against a plain, off-white background, and there is a signature in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Pa. German Chest
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
